changes: Implemented the Quantum M0-M1 claim-admissibility runtime slice: added quantum claim/evidence identity modeling, fail-closed receipt binding checks, top-level and identity outputDigest consistency, missing receipt identity handling, and a focused smoke command wired into package scripts. Updated the Quantum execution plan to state that M0-M1 is implemented while M2-M5 remain future work.
usage: Run npm --prefix packages/main run test:quantum-claim-admissibility to exercise valid bound Q5/Q12 evidence plus fail-closed stale, missing, mismatched, unbound, malformed, and over-broad evidence cases. Import evaluateQuantumClaim from packages/main/src/core/claim-admissibility/quantum.ts for the runtime evaluator.
expectedOutcome: The user should see M0-M1 Quantum claim-admissibility behavior: valid bound evidence passes, missing/stale/mismatched/unbound/malformed evidence blocks, weak overclaims degrade only when evidence is otherwise bound and current, and the smoke exits 0 with quantum claim-admissibility smoke passed.
actualTranscript: Live smoke command npm --prefix packages/main run test:quantum-claim-admissibility exited 0. Output included valid Q5 energy evidence PASS, valid Q5 basis-set-only evidence PASS, valid figure provenance PASS, stale evidence BLOCK, unbound solver output BLOCK, mismatched top-level solver output digest BLOCK, mismatched top-level energy output digest BLOCK, mismatched top-level figure provenance output digest BLOCK, missing receipt identity BLOCK, unbound plot/table BLOCK, and quantum claim-admissibility smoke passed.
outcomeDiff: No user-value behavior gap observed: the actual transcript matched the expected M0-M1 proof-or-stop behavior and includes the reviewer-driven outputDigest and missing-identity hardening cases.
limitations: This does not implement M2-M5 verifier adapters, gate policy, benchmark harness, reporting, quantum theory validation, quantum hardware validation, solver improvement, Authority DONE, production completion, or broad scientific correctness. It is a code-runtime claim-admissibility adapter slice only.
pitfalls: The story required multiple review rounds because reviewers found real fail-closed gaps: stale/missing coverage, basis-vs-grid identity semantics, hard-stop ordering, missing identity hard-stop, top-level outputDigest binding, missing receipt.identity, and non-solver outputDigest mismatches. DONE convergence also hit repeated stale evidence after main merges, a done_prepare 300-second watchdog timeout, and a stale validation lock message for a dead PID; future hosts should refresh evidence after each merge and avoid starting overlapping validation writers.
